name: Shared until
title: Shared until: in the Share panel, beside each person shared with by hand, an end for the share (a day, a week, two weeks or a month), after which it is taken away by itself

events.set: You gave a share an end, or took its end off, with Until in the Share panel

runs.ended: A share you gave an end to was taken away by itself when the end came

permissions: keeps the end you give a share in its own table, under your own ids
takes away a share whose end has passed, exactly as setting the person to None in the Share panel does, checked every minute and as the share is opened
jobs: every minute: shares whose end has passed are taken away
touches.remove: Turn the switch share_ends off on its row in Evolution, Mutations: the Share panel has no Until and nothing is taken away; ends already set wait until it is on again. To remove it for good revert night 29's share_ends commit (rouh/share_ends.py, the ShareEnd model and migration 0223, the ends route and its lines in rouh/web/guests.py and rouh/project/urls.py, its Sweeper in rouh/runtime.py, shareUntil in rouh/static/app/runs.js and its rules in app.css, this manifest) and drop the table share_ends.
